conflicts.resolution: The Legion, the Imperial fleet and the East Empire Company left at the secession, 4E 5-10 (Lore:Fourth Era; Lore:An-Xileel: the An-Xileel defeated the Imperial forces before 4E 48; Hierem's 4E 47 visit was secret). Replace 'after 4E 48' / 'until 4E 48' for any Imperial departure with 'at the secession'; Imperial forts were re-held by the Archwardens or left empty from then.

'4E 6' is the canon date of the invasion of southern Morrowind (Lore:An-Xileel), not of the province closing. Write 'at the secession' for Imperial and Company departures; keep '4E 6' only for the Morrowind strip.
Canon 3E 433: gates opened and the Argonians poured into the Deadlands (Lore:An-Xileel). No 'Oblivion Crisis storms'; no Legion recall dated to it. Rustmoth: 'not Imperial since the secession'.
No Kothringi lives or serves after 2E 603 (Lore:Knahaten Flu). Eurydike's knights served a Second-Era garrison and died in the Flu; the hall has stood empty since.

Lilmothiit withdrew from the coasts inland toward Blackrose over generations, and the Flu finished the remnant (Lore:Lilmothiit). A den is 'left in the long withdrawal' or 'emptied by the Flu', never a Flu-time flight that implies survivors.

Archwardens raise revenue only by tolls at crossings and customs at ports (spine 10.2); no tax-farmers, collectors or census in the villages. Cut those; a village's quarrel with the state is over a toll or a fort.
Argonia has no navy and no warden cutters or patrol boats (state §2.3). A fleeing smuggler runs from a chartered Archon privateer or a rival crew.
Warden forts are held by ex-Archein families garrisoning them in the Archwardens' name (Warden Marches). Gysilla's history and the lake's present must say the same holder.
Umbriel's path missed the interior (state §3): its tribes never left, so nothing was 'held since the tribes returned'. Date the station from the tribe's own use, undated.
The state's formal seat at Helstrom is EXTRAPOLATED (state §1), not CANON; only 'capital' in the Simulacrum is canon (Lore:Kingdom of Black Marsh). Retier the note.
The invasion sailed in 3E 288 (Lore:Akavir), not the 3E 270s.
The Mages Guild dissolved before 4E 48 (Lore:Mages Guild). Thorn's named places are 3E (Simulacrum); the old guild hall is empty or put to another use.
Black Marsh was not a party to the Great War (4E 171-175); its one effect here is the Leyawiin closure. Date Ysan's founding to the settled period after 4E 48, not to the Great War.
